Space Superiority Interceptor''', also referred to as the '''TIE/ba interceptor''', '''TIE Baron''', or '''TIE Interceptor''' and '''TIE/in''' was a model of [[TIE series|TIE]] [[interceptor]] deployed by the [[First Order]]. [[Elrik Vonreg's TIE Interceptor|One ship]] was used by [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] during the [[Cold War]] in his encounters with the [[New Republic]] and the [[Resistance]]. ==Characteristics== The TIE/ba [[Baron]] Space Superiority [[Interceptor]] was a class of interceptor that was manufactured by [[Sienar-Jaemus Fleet Systems]] for the [[First Order]]. The TIE Baron was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] due to the First Order equipping its higher-end models with modern technology,{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/the-recruit-episode-guide|text="The Recruit" Part 2 Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} and its all-[[Color|crimson]] design suggested the pilot's skills far surpassed those of the [[First Order Special Forces|Special Forces]] [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter|TIE]] [[pilot]]s, who flew in ships adorned with a red stripe only. [[File:Holo-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|[["Holo"]] piloting their TIE/sa Baron Interceptor during a skirmish.]] The TIE Baron was equipped with four [[solar collector]] wings and an [[antenna]] on the ship's [[cockpit]]. The [[twin ion engine]]s were powered by two ion reactors with [[pre-charged deuterium power cell]]s, which were capable of achieving an atmospheric speed of 1,250 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]], as well as [[Sublight engine|sublight]] speeds of 145 [[Megalight per hour|MGLT]]. It was armed with four wingtip [[L-s9.7 laser cannon]]s and [[projectile launcher]]s capable of firing [[ST7 concussion missile]]s and [[mag-pulse warhead]]s. It was well-protected with shielding and contained an ejector seat. The [[starfighter]] was equipped with a class 2 [[hyperdrive]]. First Order [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] personally helped guide the enhancement of previous designs to create the TIE Baron, and it was engineered to be precise and lethal. It was crewed by a single [[pilot]], and managed by an [[Experimental flight computer (TIE/ba Baron Space Superiority Interceptor)|experimental]] [[Torplex]] [[flight computer]]. ==Role== The TIE Baron was an interceptor craft used for combat, and often struck fear against [[Resistance]] [[pilot]]s who encountered them. A single TIE Baron could successfully engage an entire [[squadron]] of fighters. ==History== The TIE Baron saw use by the First Order during the [[Cold War]] with the [[New Republic]] and the [[Resistance]]. Major Elrik Vonreg used his TIE Baron in [[34 ABY]] when he ambushed a [[New Republic]] [[Kazuda Xiono's team|squadron]] led by [[Kazuda Xiono]] on a [[mission to rendezvous with the Resistance]]. Vonreg was forced to retreat once Resistance reinforcements arrived in the form of [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] and a [[Unidentified CR90 corvette (Resistance)|CR90 corvette]].
[[File:EmbersTIE-MajorVonregsTIE.png|thumb|right|270px|[["Ember"]]'s TIE patrolling with pair of TIE/sf fighters.]]
Sometime later, Vonreg led [[Elrik Vonreg's squadron|his squadron]] to [[Station Theta Black]] to escort [[Captain]] [[Phasma]] and her [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class command shuttle]], where he once again encountered Dameron and Xiono and engaged them in combat, although they were able to escape.{{Resistance|Station Theta Black (episode)}} Eventually, Dameron and Xiono again met up and launched an [[mission to the Dassal system]], where they found celestial bodies with their cores drilled out. Their presence alerted a [[spider probe droid]], which notified Major Vonreg. Another engagement ensued, although Dameron and Xiono were able to escape once again.{{Resistance|The Core Problem}} Once the [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupation]] of the ''[[Colossus]]'' began and a full [[Colossus garrison|garrison]] arrived, Vonreg and his squadron patrolled the surrounding area and were incorporated in the [[garrison]].{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 1}} Vonreg fought in his TIE Baron again when forces loyal to the Resistance and led by Xiono engaged the First Order to liberate themselves. During the [[Battle of Castilon|battle]], Vonreg was [[Death|killed]] when his TIE Baron was shot down by Xiono in battle.{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}} ==Behind the scenes== The TIE Baron first appeared in the debut episode of the [[2018]] animated series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', "[[The Recruit]]."
